---
title: "Brazil dengue: priors, α and proposals"
subtitle: "Which ddCRP prior and RJMCMC proposal work best, Paraná 2024"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
    df_print: paged
    fig_width: 10
    fig_height: 6
params:
  results_dir: "results/real_data/dengue_sensitivity_proposals"
  select_by: "min_ess"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 130)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(readr)
  library(patchwork); library(viridis); library(scales); library(forcats)
  library(knitr); library(sf)
})

# Locate the repo root, so the report knits from either the repo root or src/.
repo <- normalizePath(".", mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(file.path(repo, "src"))) repo <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = FALSE)

RES <- params$results_dir
if (!dir.exists(RES)) RES <- file.path(repo, params$results_dir)

# Every table is optional: a chunk whose input is missing says so and moves on.
have <- function(f) file.exists(file.path(RES, f))
grab <- function(f) if (have(f)) suppressMessages(read_csv(file.path(RES, f),
                                                           show_col_types = FALSE)) else NULL
skip_note <- function(f) cat(sprintf("\n> Missing `%s` in `%s`; this section is skipped.\n\n", f, RES))

cfg     <- grab("config_index.csv")
summ    <- grab("summary_sensitivity.csv")
traces  <- grab("traces.csv")
kpost   <- grab("k_posterior.csv")
metrics <- grab("metric_summary.csv")
mpairs  <- grab("metric_pairs.csv")
assign  <- grab("cluster_assignments_sensitivity.csv")
ariw    <- grab("cross_config_ari.csv")
mcomp   <- grab("model_comparison.csv")
pw      <- grab("pointwise_scores.csv")
ppcs    <- grab("ppc_stats.csv")
ppcr    <- grab("ppc_replicates.csv")
ppcp    <- grab("ppc_pointwise.csv")

# The proposal that "mixes best" in a prior × α cell: the largest
# min(ESS(K), ESS(logpost)), or that per second with select_by = "min_ess_per_sec".
SEL <- params$select_by

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
map_theme <- theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
                   panel.grid = element_blank())

if (!is.null(cfg) && !is.null(summ)) {
  # Grid order throughout: priors as listed in the script, α inferred before fixed,
  # proposals baseline first.
  PRIORS <- unique(cfg$prior_id)
  PROPS  <- unique(cfg$proposal_id)
  prior_lab <- setNames(cfg$prior_label, cfg$prior_id)[PRIORS]
  prop_lab  <- setNames(cfg$proposal_label, cfg$proposal_id)[PROPS]

  summ <- summ %>%
    left_join(select(cfg, config_id, prior_label, proposal_label), by = "config_id") %>%
    left_join(select(mcomp, config_id, waic, lpml, elpd_loo, n_bad_k), by = "config_id") %>%
    mutate(prior = factor(prior_id, levels = PRIORS, labels = prior_lab),
           proposal = factor(proposal_id, levels = PROPS, labels = prop_lab),
           alpha = ifelse(infer_alpha, "α inferred", "α fixed"),
           base_prior = sub(", α.*$", "", prior_label),
           base_prior = factor(base_prior, levels = unique(sub(", α.*$", "", prior_lab))),
           sel_value = .data[[SEL]])

  best <- summ %>% group_by(prior_id) %>% slice_max(sel_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>% arrange(prior)
  SELECTED <- best$config_id
  sel_lab <- setNames(as.character(best$prior), best$config_id)
  as_sel <- function(x) factor(x, levels = SELECTED, labels = sel_lab[SELECTED])
}

NP <- if (exists("SELECTED")) length(SELECTED) else 14
fh_stack <- function(per, pad = 2) max(4, per * NP + pad)

# Municipal polygons for every map in the report.
polys <- NULL
mesh <- list.files(file.path(repo, "data", "cleaned"), pattern = "^malha_uf[0-9]+\\.geojson$",
                   full.names = TRUE)
if (length(mesh) > 0) {
  polys <- tryCatch({
    g <- st_read(mesh[1], quiet = TRUE)
    key <- intersect(c("codarea", "CD_MUN", "code_muni"), names(g))[1]
    if (is.na(key)) NULL else { g$geocode <- as.numeric(as.character(g[[key]])); g }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}
as_map <- function(df) {
  if (!is.null(polys)) left_join(polys, df, by = "geocode")
  else st_as_sf(df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
}
map_fill <- function(v) if (!is.null(polys)) aes(fill = .data[[v]]) else aes(colour = .data[[v]])
map_geom <- function(v) if (!is.null(polys))
  geom_sf(map_fill(v), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.05) else geom_sf(map_fill(v), size = 1.1)

# elpd difference of every config in `ids` against `ref`, with its standard error.
elpd_vs <- function(ids, ref, col = "elpd_loo_i") {
  a <- pw %>% filter(config_id == ref) %>% arrange(geocode) %>% pull(.data[[col]])
  bind_rows(lapply(ids, function(id) {
    b <- pw %>% filter(config_id == id) %>% arrange(geocode) %>% pull(.data[[col]])
    d <- a - b
    tibble(config_id = id, diff = sum(d), se = sqrt(length(d) * var(d)))
  })) %>% mutate(z = ifelse(config_id == ref, NA, diff / se))
}
```

# What this study varies

The dengue application fits

$$y_i \mid \rho_k, r_k \sim \text{NegBin}\!\left(\text{mean} = E_i \rho_k,\; \text{size} = r_k\right)$$

to the `r if (!is.null(assign)) length(unique(assign$geocode)) else 399` municipalities
of Paraná under a ddCRP prior over the partition. Three things vary, and they do
different jobs:

1. **The ddCRP prior** (7 settings): the hop window at `s` = 1, 2, 3 hops, and
   the great-circle metric at `s` = 1, 5, 10 and with `s` inferred.
2. **The concentration α**: inferred under a Gamma(1, 0.01) prior, or fixed at
   α = 1.
3. **The RJMCMC proposal** (16 settings): a coordinate design over the birth
   family for ρ and r (LogNormal moment-match baseline, one parameter swapped to
   Prior, Normal moment-match or Inverse-Gamma moment-match, and an all-Prior
   reference), each with fixed-dimension moves `NoUpdate` or `Resample`.

The first two change the **posterior**. The third does not: within a prior × α
cell, every proposal targets the same posterior, so they should agree up to Monte
Carlo error and differ only in how fast they get there. The report therefore
works in two stages. It first compares proposals *within* each cell and picks
the best-mixing one (by **`r if (SEL == "min_ess") "min(ESS(K), ESS(log posterior))" else "min(ESS(K), ESS(log posterior)) per second"`**),
then compares the cells on predictive fit using that proposal's chain.

**`s` means different things for the two metrics.** For the great-circle metric
it is a rate, $\Pr(c_i = j) \propto \exp(-s\, d_{ij}/\bar d)$ with $\bar d$ the
232 km median separation, so larger `s` is a *more* local prior (decay length
about 232, 46 and 23 km at `s` = 1, 5, 10). For the hop window it is a radius:
every municipality within `s` contiguity steps is an equally likely link target
and every one beyond is suppressed, so larger `s` is a *less* local prior.

```{r design-table, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(cfg) || is.null(summ)) skip_note("config_index.csv / summary_sensitivity.csv") else {
  done <- summ %>% count(prior_id, name = "finished")
  cfg %>% count(prior_id, prior_label, name = "configs") %>%
    left_join(done, by = "prior_id") %>%
    mutate(prior_id = factor(prior_id, levels = PRIORS), finished = coalesce(finished, 0L)) %>%
    arrange(prior_id) %>%
    transmute(`prior × α` = prior_label, proposals = configs, finished) %>%
    kable(caption = sprintf("The grid: %d configurations, %d finished. Every chain runs %s iterations, burn-in %s, thinned by %d.",
                            nrow(cfg), nrow(summ), format(max(cfg$n_samples), big.mark = ","),
                            format(max(cfg$burn), big.mark = ","), max(cfg$thin))) %>%
    print()
}
```

# What each prior allows

```{r metric-table, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(metrics)) skip_note("metric_summary.csv") else {
  metrics %>%
    transmute(metric, s,
              `neighbour weight per municipality` = round(mean_row_weight, 2),
              `self-link prior probability at α = 1` = percent(1 / (1 + mean_row_weight), accuracy = 0.1),
              `pairs inside window` = ifelse(is.na(frac_in_window), "", percent(frac_in_window, accuracy = 0.1))) %>%
    kable(caption = sprintf(
      "Total prior link weight a municipality spreads over the others, and hence how likely it is a priori to start its own cluster when α is fixed at 1. The contiguity graph has %d edges, mean degree %.2f and diameter %d hops.",
      metrics$n_edges[1], metrics$mean_degree[1], metrics$graph_diameter[1])) %>%
    print()
}
```

The self-link column is what makes fixing α consequential. A hop window of
radius 1 gives each municipality about six equal-weight neighbours, so at α = 1
it starts a new cluster with prior probability of roughly one in seven; the
great-circle prior at `s` = 1 spreads weight over the whole state and makes a
self-link far less likely. Fixing α therefore fixes a different amount of
fragmentation under each metric, which inferring α is free to undo.

```{r metric-weights, fig.height = 6}
if (is.null(mpairs) || is.null(assign) || is.null(metrics)) skip_note("metric_pairs.csv") else {
  d1 <- assign %>% filter(config_id == first(config_id))
  fi <- which.max(d1$pop)
  rows <- mpairs %>% filter(i == fi | j == fi) %>%
    mutate(other = ifelse(i == fi, j, i), geocode = d1$geocode[other])
  if (nrow(rows) < 50) {
    cat("\n> The sampled pair table is too sparse for this panel at test scale.\n\n")
  } else {
    w <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(metrics)), function(k) {
      m <- metrics$metric[k]; s <- metrics$s[k]
      rows %>% transmute(geocode,
        weight = if (m == "hop") ifelse(hop <= s, 1, 0) else exp(-s * geodesic),
        panel = if (m == "hop") sprintf("hop, s = %g", s) else sprintf("geodesic, s = %g", s))
    })) %>% mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel))) %>%
      left_join(select(d1, geocode, lat, lon), by = "geocode")
    print(ggplot(w, aes(lon, lat, colour = weight)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.9) +
      geom_point(data = d1[fi, ], aes(lon, lat), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 shape = 4, size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
      scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "link weight", limits = c(0, 1)) +
      facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 3) + coord_quickmap() +
      labs(title = sprintf("Prior link weight from %s", d1$name[fi]),
           subtitle = "A cross marks the focal municipality; sampled pairs only") + map_theme)
  }
}
```

# Which proposal mixes best?

## Mixing across the whole grid

```{r ess-heat, fig.height = 7.5}
if (!exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("summary_sensitivity.csv") else {
  hm <- summ %>% select(base_prior, alpha, proposal, min_ess, min_ess_per_sec) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(min_ess, min_ess_per_sec), names_to = "what", values_to = "v") %>%
    mutate(what = recode(what, min_ess = "min(ESS(K), ESS(logpost))",
                         min_ess_per_sec = "... per second"))
  heat <- function(w) {
    d <- filter(hm, what == w)
    ggplot(d, aes(base_prior, fct_rev(proposal), fill = v)) + geom_tile(colour = "white") +
      geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(v >= 10, sprintf("%.0f", v), sprintf("%.2g", v))), size = 2.3,
                colour = "white") +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", name = NULL, option = "viridis", end = 0.9) +
      facet_wrap(~alpha) +
      labs(title = w, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 8),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5), panel.grid = element_blank())
  }
  print(heat("min(ESS(K), ESS(logpost))") / heat("... per second"))
}
```

Every chain is the same length, so the top panel compares proposals per
iteration and the bottom per unit of compute. `Resample` costs more per
iteration than `NoUpdate`, so the two panels can disagree. Timings come from
whichever cluster node ran each task, so the per-second panel carries node-to-node
noise the top one does not.

## The best proposal in each cell

```{r best-table, results = "asis"}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  runner <- summ %>% group_by(prior_id) %>% arrange(desc(sel_value), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(runner_up = sel_value[2], .groups = "drop")
  best %>% left_join(runner, by = "prior_id") %>%
    transmute(`prior × α` = as.character(prior), `best proposal` = as.character(proposal),
              `min ESS` = round(min_ess), `min ESS / s` = signif(min_ess_per_sec, 3),
              `runner-up` = round(if (SEL == "min_ess") runner_up else NA),
              `ESS(K)` = round(ess_K), `ESS(logpost)` = round(ess_logpost),
              `birth %` = round(100 * acc_birth, 2), `death %` = round(100 * acc_death, 3),
              `fixed %` = round(100 * acc_fixed, 2), `time (h)` = round(total_time / 3600, 2)) %>%
    kable(caption = sprintf("Selected proposal per prior × α, by %s. These chains are the ones the rest of the report compares.", SEL)) %>%
    print()
}
```

## Which proposal wins overall?

```{r prop-rank, fig.height = 5}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  rk <- summ %>% group_by(prior_id) %>%
    mutate(rank = rank(-sel_value, ties.method = "average"),
           rel = sel_value / max(sel_value)) %>% ungroup()
  overall <- rk %>% group_by(proposal) %>%
    summarise(mean_rank = mean(rank), median_rel = median(rel), wins = sum(rank == 1),
              cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(mean_rank)
  print(ggplot(rk, aes(fct_reorder(proposal, rank, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE), rel)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = alpha), width = 0.15, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() + scale_colour_manual(values = c("α inferred" = "#1b9e77", "α fixed" = "#d95f02"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "Mixing relative to the best proposal in the same cell",
         subtitle = "1 = best proposal for that prior × α; one point per cell",
         x = NULL, y = sprintf("%s / best in cell", SEL)))
  overall %>% transmute(proposal = as.character(proposal), `mean rank (of 16)` = round(mean_rank, 1),
                        `median relative mixing` = round(median_rel, 2),
                        `cells won` = sprintf("%d of %d", wins, cells)) %>%
    kable(caption = "Proposals ranked by their average rank across the prior × α cells.") %>% print()
}
```

```{r prop-acc, fig.height = 4.6}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  ac <- summ %>% select(proposal, alpha, acc_birth, acc_death, acc_fixed) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("acc_"), names_to = "move", values_to = "rate") %>%
    mutate(move = recode(move, acc_birth = "birth", acc_death = "death", acc_fixed = "fixed-dim"))
  print(ggplot(ac, aes(rate, fct_rev(proposal), colour = alpha)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7, position = position_jitter(height = 0.15)) +
    facet_wrap(~move, scales = "free_x") + scale_x_log10(labels = label_percent()) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("α inferred" = "#1b9e77", "α fixed" = "#d95f02"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "Acceptance rates by proposal", subtitle = "One point per prior", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5)))
}
```

## Do the proposals agree?

They target the same posterior, so within a cell mean $K$ and elpd should agree
up to Monte Carlo error. A proposal that sits well away from the others in its
cell has not converged, and its mixing numbers should not be trusted either.

```{r agree, fig.height = 6.4}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  ag <- summ %>% mutate(mcse_K = std_K / sqrt(pmax(ess_K, 1)))
  p1 <- ggplot(ag, aes(mean_K, base_prior, colour = fixed_dim)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = mean_K - 2 * mcse_K, xmax = mean_K + 2 * mcse_K),
                   height = 0, alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~alpha) + labs(title = "Posterior mean K by proposal (± 2 MCSE)", x = "mean K", y = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(NoUpdate = "grey35", Resample = "#7570b3"), name = NULL)
  p2 <- ggplot(ag, aes(elpd_loo, base_prior, colour = fixed_dim)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    facet_wrap(~alpha) + labs(title = "elpd_loo by proposal", x = "elpd_loo", y = NULL) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(NoUpdate = "grey35", Resample = "#7570b3"), name = NULL)
  print(p1 / p2 + plot_layout(guides = "collect"))
}
```

```{r agree-table, results = "asis"}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  summ %>% group_by(prior) %>%
    summarise(`mean K range` = sprintf("%.1f to %.1f", min(mean_K), max(mean_K)),
              `typical 2 MCSE` = round(2 * median(std_K / sqrt(pmax(ess_K, 1))), 1),
              `elpd_loo range` = round(max(elpd_loo) - min(elpd_loo), 1),
              `ARI of mode partitions (median)` = if (is.null(ariw)) NA else {
                ids <- config_id
                round(median(ariw$ari[ariw$config_a %in% ids & ariw$config_b %in% ids &
                                      ariw$config_a < ariw$config_b]), 2)
              }, .groups = "drop") %>%
    kable(caption = "Spread across the 16 proposals within each cell. A mean-K range much wider than 2 MCSE means some proposals have not reached the posterior.") %>%
    print()
}
```

# Inferring α or fixing it

```{r alpha-compare, fig.height = 4.6}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  pa <- best %>% select(base_prior, alpha, mean_K, elpd_loo, min_ess, alpha_post)
  panel <- function(v, lab, logy = FALSE) {
    p <- ggplot(pa, aes(base_prior, .data[[v]], fill = alpha)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("α inferred" = "#1b9e77", "α fixed" = "#d95f02"), name = NULL) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = lab) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 8))
    if (logy) p <- p + scale_y_log10()
    p
  }
  loo_panel <- ggplot(pa, aes(base_prior, elpd_loo, colour = alpha)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("α inferred" = "#1b9e77", "α fixed" = "#d95f02"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "elpd_loo") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 8))
  print((panel("mean_K", "mean K") | loo_panel | panel("min_ess", "min ESS", TRUE)) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = "Selected chain per cell: α inferred against α fixed at 1"))
}
```

```{r alpha-text, results = "asis"}
if (exists("SELECTED") && !is.null(pw)) {
  pairs <- best %>% select(base_prior, alpha, config_id, elpd_loo, alpha_post) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = alpha, values_from = c(config_id, elpd_loo, alpha_post))
  if (all(c("config_id_α inferred", "config_id_α fixed") %in% names(pairs))) {
    pairs <- pairs %>% filter(!is.na(`config_id_α inferred`), !is.na(`config_id_α fixed`))
    tab <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
      d <- elpd_vs(pairs$`config_id_α fixed`[k], pairs$`config_id_α inferred`[k])
      tibble(prior = as.character(pairs$base_prior[k]),
             `posterior mean α (inferred)` = signif(pairs$`alpha_post_α inferred`[k], 3),
             `elpd_loo gain from inferring α` = round(d$diff, 1), se = round(d$se, 1),
             `in se` = round(d$z, 1))
    }))
    kable(tab, caption = "Positive gain means inferring α predicts better than fixing it at 1.") %>% print()
  }
}
```

# The selected chains

Everything from here uses one chain per prior × α cell, the best-mixing
proposal from the table above.

```{r diag-table, results = "asis"}
if (exists("SELECTED")) {
  best %>% transmute(`prior × α` = as.character(prior), proposal = as.character(proposal),
                     `mean K` = round(mean_K, 1), `mode K` = mode_K, `sd K` = round(std_K, 1),
                     `ESS(K)` = round(ess_K), `ESS(logpost)` = round(ess_logpost),
                     `ESS s` = round(ess_s), `ESS α` = round(ess_alpha),
                     `post. α` = signif(alpha_post, 3),
                     `post. s` = ifelse(infer_s, signif(s_post, 3), NA),
                     `death %` = round(100 * acc_death, 3)) %>%
    kable(caption = "Mixing of the selected chains.") %>% print()
}
```

```{r traces, fig.height = fh_stack(0.9)}
if (is.null(traces) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("traces.csv") else {

    pivot_longer(c(K, logpost, alpha_ddcrp, s_ddcrp), names_to = "q", values_to = "v") %>%
    mutate(q = factor(recode(q, K = "K", logpost = "log posterior",
                             alpha_ddcrp = "α", s_ddcrp = "s"),
                      levels = c("K", "log posterior", "α", "s")))
  print(ggplot(tl, aes(draw, v)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.22, colour = "grey25") +

    labs(title = "Traces of the selected chains", x = "stored draw", y = NULL) +
    theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          strip.placement = "outside", axis.text = element_text(size = 6)))
}
```

```{r pk, fig.height = 6}
if (is.null(kpost) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("k_posterior.csv") else {

    left_join(select(best, config_id, base_prior, alpha), by = "config_id")

}
```

$K$ is a count, so its posterior is drawn as bars rather than a line.

# Which prior predicts best?

WAIC, LPML and PSIS-LOO are comparable across cells because the likelihood is
identical and only the prior over partitions differs. The standard error of a
difference in elpd is $\sqrt{n\,\mathrm{var}(a_i - b_i)}$ over matched
municipalities; a gap under about two standard errors is not a meaningful
preference.

```{r model-comp, results = "asis"}
if (!exists("SELECTED") || is.null(pw)) skip_note("pointwise_scores.csv") else {
  top <- best$config_id[which.max(best$elpd_loo)]
  d <- elpd_vs(SELECTED, top)
  best %>% left_join(d, by = "config_id") %>% arrange(desc(elpd_loo)) %>%
    transmute(`prior × α` = as.character(prior), proposal = as.character(proposal),
              `mean K` = round(mean_K, 1), WAIC = round(waic, 1), LPML = round(lpml, 1),
              elpd_loo = round(elpd_loo, 1),
              `shortfall` = ifelse(config_id == top, "best", sprintf("%.1f", diff)),
              se = ifelse(config_id == top, "", sprintf("%.1f", se)),
              `in se` = ifelse(config_id == top, "", sprintf("%.1f", z)),
              `k>0.7` = n_bad_k) %>%
    kable(caption = "Selected chains ranked by elpd_loo, with each one's shortfall against the best.") %>% print()
}
```

```{r model-comp-plot, fig.height = 4.6}
if (exists("SELECTED") && !is.null(pw)) {
  top <- best$config_id[which.max(best$elpd_loo)]
  d <- elpd_vs(SELECTED, top) %>% left_join(select(best, config_id, prior, alpha), by = "config_id")
  print(ggplot(d, aes(-diff, fct_reorder(prior, -diff))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = -diff - 2 * se, xmax = -diff + 2 * se, colour = alpha), height = 0) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = alpha), size = 2.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("α inferred" = "#1b9e77", "α fixed" = "#d95f02"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "elpd_loo relative to the best cell (± 2 SE)", x = "elpd_loo difference", y = NULL))
}
```

# The fitted partitions

Maps use the **mode partition**: the highest log-posterior draw among those
whose cluster count equals the posterior mode of $K$.

```{r mode-maps, fig.height = max(4, 2.8 * ceiling(NP / 4) + 1.4)}
if (is.null(assign) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("cluster_assignments_sensitivity.csv") else {
  md <- assign %>% filter(config_id %in% SELECTED) %>% mutate(cid = as_sel(config_id)) %>%
    group_by(config_id, cluster_mode) %>%
    mutate(cluster_rate = median(rho_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
  print(ggplot(as_map(md)) +
    (if (!is.null(polys)) geom_sf(aes(fill = cluster_rate), colour = NA)
     else geom_sf(aes(colour = cluster_rate), size = 0.7)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", option = "magma", name = "fitted\nper 100k",
                         labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(trans = "log10", option = "magma", name = "fitted\nper 100k") +
    facet_wrap(~cid, ncol = 4) +
    labs(title = "Mode partition, shaded by each cluster's fitted incidence",
         subtitle = "Same colour scale throughout, so panels compare directly") +
    map_theme + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7.5)))
}
```

```{r ari-heat, fig.height = max(4.5, 0.42 * NP + 2.4)}
if (is.null(ariw) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("cross_config_ari.csv") else {
  h <- ariw %>% filter(config_a %in% SELECTED, config_b %in% SELECTED) %>%
    mutate(a = as_sel(config_a), b = as_sel(config_b),
           lab_col = ifelse(ari > 0.55, "black", "white"))
  print(ggplot(h, aes(a, b, fill = ari)) + geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", ari), colour = lab_col), size = 2.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), oob = squish, name = "ARI") +
    labs(title = "Adjusted Rand index between mode partitions of the selected chains", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7), panel.grid = element_blank()))
}
```

# Posterior predictive checks

A discrepancy statistic the model cannot reproduce shows up as a posterior
predictive p-value near 0 or 1. Moran's I of log incidence is the one the
spatial prior is meant to control.

```{r ppc-table, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(ppcs) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("ppc_stats.csv") else {
  ppcs %>% filter(config_id %in% SELECTED) %>% mutate(cid = as.character(as_sel(config_id))) %>%
    select(cid, statistic, ppp) %>%
    mutate(ppp = ifelse(ppp < 0.05 | ppp > 0.95, sprintf("**%.3f**", ppp), sprintf("%.3f", ppp))) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = statistic, values_from = ppp) %>%
    mutate(cid = factor(cid, levels = sel_lab[SELECTED])) %>% arrange(cid) %>%
    rename(`prior × α` = cid) %>%
    kable(caption = "Posterior predictive p-values; bold marks ppp outside [0.05, 0.95].") %>% print()
}
```

```{r ppc-hist, fig.height = fh_stack(0.8)}
if (is.null(ppcr) || is.null(ppcs) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("ppc_replicates.csv") else {
  rr <- ppcr %>% filter(config_id %in% SELECTED) %>% mutate(cid = as_sel(config_id))
  ob <- ppcs %>% filter(config_id %in% SELECTED) %>% mutate(cid = as_sel(config_id))
  print(ggplot(rr, aes(T_rep)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey55") +
    geom_vline(data = ob, aes(xintercept = T_obs), colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(cid ~ statistic, scales = "free") +
    labs(title = "Replicate statistics against the observed value (red)", x = NULL, y = "replicates") +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 6.5),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 7), axis.text = element_text(size = 6)))
}
```

```{r pit, fig.height = max(4, 2.1 * ceiling(NP / 4) + 1.4)}
if (is.null(ppcp) || !exists("SELECTED")) skip_note("ppc_pointwise.csv") else {
```

```{r ppc-resid-map, fig.height = 5}
if (!is.null(ppcp) && exists("SELECTED") && !is.null(assign)) {
  b1 <- best$config_id[which.max(best$elpd_loo)]
  w1 <- best$config_id[which.min(best$elpd_loo)]
  rd <- ppcp %>% filter(config_id %in% c(b1, w1)) %>%
    left_join(select(filter(assign, config_id == b1), geocode, lat, lon), by = "geocode") %>%
    mutate(z = (y_obs - yrep_mean) / pmax(sqrt(pmax(yrep_mean, 1)), 1),
           cid = factor(config_id, levels = c(b1, w1),
                        labels = c(paste0("best: ", sel_lab[b1]), paste0("worst: ", sel_lab[w1]))))
  print(ggplot(as_map(rd)) +
    (if (!is.null(polys)) geom_sf(aes(fill = z), colour = NA) else geom_sf(aes(colour = z), size = 0.8)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "grey92", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0,
                         name = "std.\nresidual",
                         limits = c(-1, 1) * quantile(abs(rd$z), 0.97, na.rm = TRUE), oob = squish) +
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "grey92", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0,
                           name = "std.\nresidual") +
    facet_wrap(~cid) +
    labs(title = "Standardised posterior predictive residuals, best and worst elpd_loo",
         subtitle = "Spatial structure left in the residuals is structure the prior did not capture") +
    map_theme + theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8)))
}
```

# The best metric and proposal combination

```{r conclusions, results = "asis"}
if (exists("SELECTED") && !is.null(pw)) {
  top <- best$config_id[which.max(best$elpd_loo)]
  d <- elpd_vs(SELECTED, top) %>% left_join(best, by = "config_id")
  tied <- d %>% filter(config_id == top | z < 2) %>% arrange(desc(sel_value))
  mor <- if (is.null(ppcs)) NULL else ppcs %>% filter(grepl("^Moran", statistic)) %>% select(config_id, ppp)
  rk <- summ %>% group_by(prior_id) %>% mutate(rank = rank(-sel_value)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(proposal) %>% summarise(mean_rank = mean(rank), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(mean_rank)
  pick <- tied[1, ]
  cat(sprintf("
1. **Best predictive fit:** %s, elpd_loo %.1f. %s

2. **Best combination:** among the cells within 2 SE of the best, the best-mixing is **%s with proposal %s** (%s = %s)%s.

3. **Best proposal overall:** %s, with mean rank %.1f of %d across all %d prior × α cells. The runner-up is %s (mean rank %.1f).
",
    sel_lab[top], d$elpd_loo[d$config_id == top],
    if (nrow(tied) > 1) sprintf("%d other cell%s within 2 SE of it: %s.", nrow(tied) - 1,
                                ifelse(nrow(tied) == 2, " is", "s are"),
                                paste(sprintf("%s (%.1f SE)", sel_lab[tied$config_id[tied$config_id != top]],
                                              tied$z[tied$config_id != top]), collapse = "; "))
    else "No other cell is within 2 SE of it.",
    sel_lab[pick$config_id], as.character(pick$proposal), SEL, signif(pick$sel_value, 3),
    if (!is.null(mor)) sprintf(", Moran's I ppp %.2f", mor$ppp[mor$config_id == pick$config_id]) else "",
    as.character(rk$proposal[1]), rk$mean_rank[1], length(PROPS), length(PRIORS),
    as.character(rk$proposal[2]), rk$mean_rank[2]))
}
```

## Caveats

- **Proposal choice is judged on two ESS numbers.** `min(ESS(K), ESS(log posterior))`
  is a coarse summary of mixing over a partition space; a proposal can score
  well on it and still move slowly in directions neither statistic sees. The
  agreement section above is the check on that.
- **One chain per configuration.** Convergence is judged by agreement across
  proposals within a cell, not by multi-chain R̂, and every chain uses seed 42.
- **Fixed α = 1 is not a neutral value.** It implies a different prior
  self-link probability under each metric (table in Section 3), so "α fixed"
  compares different amounts of prior fragmentation, not one.
- **`s` means two things**: a decay rate for the great-circle metric, a window
  radius for the hop metric, so a value of `s` is only comparable within a
  metric.
- **The hop window's truncation floor** suppresses rather than forbids distant
  links, at $e^{-30}$ relative weight, since an exact zero would put $-\infty$
  into the log-posterior.

# Reproducing this

```
Rscript src/prepare_dengue_adjacency.R --uf 41
julia --project=. src/dengue_sensitivity.jl --pilot       # per-task cost
bash src/slurm/submit_dengue_sensitivity.sh               # array job, then collect
Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("src/dengue_sensitivity_analysis.rmd")'
```
